text: {"label":"Acquired Brain Injury Rehabilitation","definition":"Behavior-analytic assessment and intervention for people with acquired or traumatic brain injury, including problem behavior, verbal and academic skill recovery, delay discounting, caregiver support, staff training, and rehabilitation service settings.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Defined by neurological injury acquired after birth and rehabilitation care, not self-injurious behavior, psychological trauma and trauma-informed care, or lifelong developmental disabilities."}
